mapper.sql: id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, topic, message_key, payload, publish_state, retry_count, next_retry_time, published_at, last_error, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vso_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, topic, message_key, payload, publish_state, retry_count, description, create_time, row_version, row_valid) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, #{payload}, #{publishState}, #{retryCount}, #{description}, now(), 1, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vso_outbox t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.publish_state IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE') AND (t.next_retry_time IS NULL OR t.next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE vso_outbox t SET t.publish_state = 'PUBLISHED', t.published_at = now(), t.last_error = NULL, t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now() WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1

UPDATE vso_outbox t SET t.publish_state = 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', t.retry_count = #{retryCount}, t.next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, t.last_error = #{error}, t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now() WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1
UPDATE vso_outbox t SET t.publish_state = 'DEAD', t.last_error = #{error}, t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now() WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1
